prompt: Add a configurable ceiling to exponential retry delays. Introduce max_delay_ms on RetryConfig with a default of 500. Ensure retry calculations clamp each delay to this cap while retaining exponential growth below the cap and zero-base behavior. Ensure Client uses the same capped retry schedule. Update the relevant tests for default, capped, and zero-base behavior. Preserve max_attempts and unrelated files and behavior.

Make Ledger event application idempotent and atomic. Track event IDs across successful applications. Applying an event ID more than once must return a Duplicate outcome without changing the balance. A withdrawal that fails for insufficient funds must preserve the existing error and must not record its event ID, so the same event can succeed later after a deposit. Successful deposits and withdrawals must record their IDs exactly once. Preserve existing balance and error behavior and update the visible tests.
